resources.string: Power-saving steps in sleep, for finding sleep problems

These steps decide how deeply the console sleeps. Turning some off can stop a console from freezing in sleep, but it uses more battery while asleep. A change counts from the next sleep and stays after a restart. If the console doesn\'t wake up, hold Power for 7 seconds.
This system can\'t change the sleep steps.
Also turn the logic power domain off (ARMOFF_LOGOFF)
Put the RAM in power-down mode (ARMOFF_DDRPD)
Run the power controller on its slow 32 kHz clock (PMU_PMUALIVE_32K)
Stop the clocks of idle parts of the chip (CLK_GT)
Put the power chip in low-power mode and lower the voltages (PMIC_LP)
Plugging in a cable or USB device can wake the console (USB_WKUP_EN)
Idle cores turn off completely. Off: they only stop their clock, using a little more battery. Counts right away (cpu-sleep)
When all four cores are idle, the whole core group turns off. Off: uses a little more battery. Counts right away (cluster-sleep)
